title: macrochloa arenaria
intro: Macrochloa arenaria, commonly known as Beach Grass or Sea Grass, is a type of perennial grass that grows in sandy coastal areas. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Macrochloa arenaria include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Macrochloa arenaria include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
